title: Figure 4.3: 3D Surface Plots of IEC Q-value Including Electron Losses
description: Four wireframe 3D surface plots labeled [a]-[d] showing fusion gain Q as a function of normalized maximum source strength (Ŝmax) paired with γ, fe, or E0 (keV). The caption reads 'Plot of the Q-value (including electron losses) as a Function of (a) Ŝmax and γ with fe=10^-3, (b) Ŝmax and fe with γ = 5, (c) Ŝmax and fe with γ = 100, and (d) Ŝmax and E0 with γ= 5 and fe =10^-3', noting E0 = 100 keV except in (d).
